documentation.content:
An API or website server logged an ERROR (or worse).

Open Logs Explorer with `severity>=ERROR` for the service named in this alert, then open the entry and click its trace or copy its `jsonPayload.requestId` to see every line of the same request. Grouped issues: Error Reporting. Runbook: docs/observability/README.md.
